snippet.title: LunaGenesis demo trailer
snippet.description:
LunaGenesis: a single-player psychological horror adventure about Scary Moonchild, an avatar of Will who sneaks through a plague-ridden rat-folk town and dives into surreal dreams to expose the Collegium's hidden conspiracy.

Demo is out on steam and itch.io now!
